stage2_output.decision_rationale: Full text is available and in English. The paper is a primary research article with original contributions (a new annotated dataset, annotation schema/guidelines, and baselines). It specifically concerns process extraction from natural-language text, including extracting process-model elements and relations from textual process descriptions. It also presents concrete methods and empirical validation via dataset construction procedure and reported baseline experiments.
